author: Brandt, 1841
summary: 관목림과 농경지 주변에 사는 새로, 아시아와 인도에 분포한다. 나무 위나 관목림의 덤불 속에 둥지를 틀고 알 3~5개를 낳는다. 주로 식물 씨앗을 먹는다.

sexes.male: 머리와 가슴이 적갈색이고 등은 녹색을 띠며 배는 노랗다.
sexes.female: 수컷보다 색이 엷으며 등은 회갈색, 머리는 갈색이다.

young: 어린새는 암컷처럼 수수한 회갈색이고 등에 갈색 줄무늬가 있으며, 가을 어린새는 노란색이 아래꼬리덮깃에만 남는다. 검은머리멧새의 암컷·어린새와 매우 비슷해 현장에서 가려내기 어렵다.

similar.how: 수컷은 머리와 가슴이 붉은 밤색이고 등이 녹황색이라 바로 구별되지만, 암컷과 어린새는 아주 비슷해 정수리 줄무늬가 흐리고 등 줄무늬가 더 뚜렷하며 허리에 밤색 기가 없는 점으로 가린다.

art.subject: Red-headed Bunting (Emberiza bruniceps), adult male in breeding plumage, a spring vagrant in Korea: whole head, throat and upper breast chestnut-red, forming a hood; mantle and scapulars yellowish-green with fine dark streaks; rump yellowish; wings dark brown with pale greyish fringes; underparts from the lower breast to the undertail bright yellow; tail plain dark brown without white outer feathers. Bill large, conical, grey; eye dark; legs pinkish-brown.
art.pose: perched on top of a shrub, side view
art.scene: shrubland bordering farmland; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male breeding plumage (spring–summer), side view perched: chestnut-red hood over head, throat and upper breast, yellowish-green back with fine dark streaks, bright yellow belly and undertail, plain dark tail without white, heavy grey bill

adult female, side view perched: much paler and plainer than the male, brown head and grey-brown back with fine dark streaks on the crown and mantle, pale buffy-yellow underparts with yellow undertail coverts, no white in the tail
art.build: A large, robust bunting, 17cm, clearly bigger than a sparrow, with a big head, heavy body and fairly long tail; perches upright on bush tops. Bill large and conical for a bunting, deep at the base, grey, shorter than the head. Legs pinkish-brown, medium length. Long wings, the primaries projecting well beyond the tertials. Tail medium-long and slightly notched, plain dark brown with no white sides.
avoid: Do not paint a black cap or chestnut back — that is Black-headed Bunting; Red-headed has a chestnut hood and a green back.
Do not paint chestnut upperparts and rump (male Chestnut Bunting, a small common migrant in Korea).
Do not paint white outer tail feathers; the tail is plain.
Do not extend the chestnut onto the belly; it stops at the upper breast.
